additional_info.subject: RE: ID0423015-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002642] Restart issue CRM:02698000111
additional_info.body:
Hi Matteo,
I hope you are doing well.
We have checked the charger and found that it is online on SCB but in Failsafe Mode. We also attempted a reboot via SCB; however, the charger continues to boot into Failsafe Mode. At this stage, we don’t see any active error flags related to individual components, aside from the Failsafe Mode itself. Additionally, we have not observed any unreachable IPs.
To investigate further, we are creating a child case for Expert Support. Once the analysis is complete, either they or we will get in touch with you to share the findings or discuss the next steps.
Thank you for your patience and continued support.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: Failsafe Mode Confluence reason
additional_info.body:
To be specific: the health service on the Linux is responsible to set this mode, see furhter documentation here: Logs#,Health%2Dservice,-sicharge%2Dhealth%2Dservice or here sicharge-health-service
We noticed that there are no active error flags related to individual components, aside from the Failsafe Mode itself. Additionally, we have not observed any unreachable IPs. During the boot-up process, we also saw multiple "healthy services" messages, but it appears that some services are failing repeatedly during startup. Please refer to the logs attached in the note below.

additional_info.subject: Note to ES Team
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
Seems
the health service on the Linux is responsible to set Failsafe mode
Problem Description:
The charger is restarting multiple times and consistently booting into Failsafe Mode.
Action Performed (L2):
reboot via SCB; however, the charger continues to boot into Failsafe Mode. At this stage, we don’t see any active error flags related to individual components, aside from the Failsafe Mode itself. Additionally, we have not observed any unreachable IPs.
During the boot-up process, we also saw multiple "healthy services" messages, but it appears that some services are failing repeatedly during startup. Please refer to the logs attached in the note below.
Charger SW Version:
v6.1.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further investigation
Fault history:
NA
Log analysis with timestamp:
Timestamped log messages are attached in the note below.
Action Required by HQ:
Further investigation or performing health services related activity as per the confluence.

Note:
Unable to create a child case, so this is being directly handed over to the ES team for further investigation.

additional_info.subject: 0423015 - ID0423015-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002642] IPlanet- Restart issue CRM:00472000294
additional_info.body:
Hello Matteo,
I noticed 2 problems on this charger. First the Ecog had an invalid pilot state on the CCS plug. I could solve it installing the layer 1.4.11 on it.
Second issue is on router 2, the internal modem is not working. First thing to do is to inspect if the SIM is working. If you don't find any issue on the SIM card, please proceed to replace the router.
When going on site take already a spare router since I think is the most probably the root cause of this issue.
The charger is now available but without OCPP connection.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
